$comment: Where Atmos looks for official packages (see core/js/core/extension-manager.cjs). Each source is a folder or an https:// address with a signed index.json. The official one is the latest GitHub release of the public repo: its assets are the .atmos packages and index.json (npm run pack:extensions -- --from <export>). An installed Atmos also offers these in its first-run picker. "download" is the page "Atmos X is available" opens (the version comes from a source's signed index; the address only ever from here).
